The only bad experience in Vietnam
Apr 2025 • Friends
Our drinks were serviced way after food was served. Beef brisket was horrible, so hard to chew. The service was extremely poor. We were a party of 24. They did not have printed menus or even a bar code for ordering drinks. Just one tablet was circulated. I asked for a glass of wine. They opened a page and I picked one. At the it turned out the page they showed me was for wines by the bottle. It was very difficult to communicate in English. Mediocre food, very poor service. DO NOT RECOMMEND

Worst restaurant I’ve ever been to.
Jun 2022 • Family
Went there for my mom’s birthday, wanted to give her a wonderful dinner, however, the experience is completely nightmare.

Tips: 
- If you can’t handle someone shouting at you, don’t go there, the voice of the waitress is pretty high and intense, it’s s kind of stressful.
- If you want to ask for something (in my case it was a glass of ice), better to ask at least 3 times with 3 different waiters, the last time, you should higher your voice so they will notice you.
- It’s healthier to drink alcohol and soda cause it’s cheaper than mineral water, the water cost 155,000vnd ++

The only thing that saved the night is the food. Anyway, I don’t wanna waste 5 million for dinner and give myself more stress. Will not go back there again and definitely not recommend for anyone.

It was OK, not coming back
Jan 2019 • Couples
We have being to Brazilian Steak Houses in many countries, including Brazil, so far this one was the worse. Nothing reminds us of the taste of the Brazilian food. They don’t have the traditional salad bar, they bring some lettuce to your table. The picanha and all the other meats taste sweet and remind us more of Vietnamese food than Brazilian. The service was nice and the employees very courteous but it didn’t make up for the lack o authenticity. We will not recommend this restaurant as a Brazilian Steak House or even as a good place to have a meal.
